name: foodbridge
description: FoodBridge: connects surplus food from restaurants, canteens and hostels with volunteers and NGOs, with an expiry countdown and a side game.

scripts.dev:all: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix web-portal run dev
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix game-client install && npm --prefix web-portal install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
